learning_outcomes.text: Convert theoretical knowledge into practice through laboratory and project work
Gain the ability to work in a team and individually

syllabus_topics: Introduction of laboratory measurement devices and experiment sheets
Application of Ohm's law and Kirchhoff's current and voltage laws
Application of finding Thevenin/Norton equivalent circuit
Experimental application of maximum power transfer theorem
Inverting/non-inverting, summing, and differential op-amp circuit applications
Experimental application of natural and step responses of series RL and RC circuits
Experimental application of natural and step responses of parallel RL and RC circuits
Experimental application of natural and step responses of series and parallel RLC circuits
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course schedule. Midterm and final exam dates are held on the dates specified in the academic calendar by the decision of the University Senate.
